rows.label: regular wave in a flume
rows.card:
# method-selection decision

## profile
- acoustic_mach: 0.03
- has_free_surface: True
- gravity_waves: True
- shock_advection: False
- capillary_dominated: False
- density_ratio: 1.0
- reynolds: 100.0
- thermal_transport: False
- tensile_stretching: False
- smooth_inviscid_vortex: False
- domain: closed

## verdict
- accuracy bound: 5.53% over every live accuracy record of the schemes put forward (owner standard 15%) -- set by compression_regularization (XVAL-SPHINXSYS-COMPRESSION-DENSITY-REGULARIZATION)
- within owner standard: YES

## primary scheme
- wcsph_delta_sph: SELECTED
- why: [free_surface] free surface with acoustic Mach 0.03 < 0.1: the weakly compressible branch is the implemented free-surface solver
- claimed bound: 2.97% (owner standard 15%; passing records only)
- reference: Antuono, Colagrossi & Marrone (2010) Comput. Phys. Commun. 181:532; Monaghan (1992) J. Comput. Phys. 110:399 (XSPH)

## modifiers
- density_diffusion: SELECTED -- free-surface flow keeps delta-SPH density diffusion (delta=0.1)
- compression_regularization: SELECTED -- long-running nearly-incompressible free-surface runs may add compression-based density regularisation instead of delta-SPH
    - XVAL-SPHINXSYS-COMPRESSION-DENSITY-REGULARIZATION: max interior-band hydrostatic pressure error vs analytic p = rho0 g (H - y), SPHinXsys reference-mean arm = 5.53% misses its own 1% gate but is inside 15% (benchmarks/xval_sphinxsys_compression/records.json)

## strict bound (worst live accuracy record <= 15%)
- nothing excluded: every scheme put forward is inside the owner standard

- within owner standard: YES

## primary scheme
- isph_projection: SELECTED
- why: [wall_bounded] domain='closed' with Re=1: a divergence-free projection solve is the preferred branch, WCSPH no-slip walls the fallback
- claimed bound: 0.867% (owner standard 15%; passing records only)
- reference: Cummins & Rudman (1999) J. Comput. Phys. 152:584

## modifiers
- none

## strict bound (worst live accuracy record <= 15%)
- excluded wcsph_wall_no_slip [primary]: worst live accuracy record 17.1% (CASE-COUETTE-VISCOUS-TIME (moving wall, H/dx=16): wall-shear error at the MOVING wall, |1 - tau_SPH/tau_exact|, at the steady end of the viscous-time sweep, H/dx=16 (the bottom-wall reading alone does not evidence the whole no-slip condition)) exceeds the 15% owner standard

## notes
- strict bound: wcsph_wall_no_slip is evidence-backed (SELECTED) but worst live accuracy record 17.1% (CASE-COUETTE-VISCOUS-TIME (moving wall, H/dx=16): wall-shear error at the MOVING wall, |1 - tau_SPH/tau_exact|, at the steady end of the viscous-time sweep, H/dx=16 (the bottom-wall reading alone does not evidence the whole no-slip condition)) exceeds the 15% owner standard
- wcsph_wall_no_slip preferred by rule 'wall_bounded' but SELECTED: CASE-COUETTE-VISCOUS-TIME (steady-state envelope, H/dx=8): wall-shear error |1 - tau_SPH/tau_exact| at the steady end of the viscous-time sweep (longest run whose steady_drift passes the 1 % gate), H/dx=8 = 9.55% misses its own 5% gate but is inside 15% (benchmarks/couette/out_design/viscous_time_convergence.json); CASE-COUETTE-VISCOUS-TIME (reading mobility, H/dx=8): mobility of the wall-shear reading across the admissible viscous-time sweep (max - min, percentage points), H/dx=8: how much the accuracy claim would move if the run were stopped earlier = 18.3% -- a conditioning record (kind=robustness), not an error against a reference: reported for transparency, excluded from the accuracy bound (benchmarks/couette/out_design/viscous_time_convergence.json); CASE-COUETTE-VISCOUS-TIME (reading mobility, H/dx=16): mobility of the wall-shear reading across the admissible viscous-time sweep (max - min, percentage points), H/dx=16: how much the accuracy claim would move if the run were stopped earlier = 0% -- a conditioning record (kind=robustness), not an error against a reference: reported for transparency, excluded from the accuracy bound (benchmarks/couette/out_design/viscous_time_convergence.json); CASE-COUETTE-VISCOUS-TIME (moving wall, H/dx=8): wall-shear error at the MOVING wall, |1 - tau_SPH/tau_exact|, at the steady end of the viscous-time sweep, H/dx=8 (the bottom-wall reading alone does not evidence the whole no-slip condition) = 14.2% misses its own 5% gate but is inside 15% (benchmarks/couette/out_design/viscous_time_convergence.json); CASE-COUETTE-VISCOUS-TIME (moving wall, H/dx=16): wall-shear error at the MOVING wall, |1 - tau_SPH/tau_exact|, at the steady end of the viscous-time sweep, H/dx=16 (the bottom-wall reading alone does not evidence the whole no-slip condition) = 17.1% exceeds the 15% owner standard (benchmarks/couette/out_design/viscous_time_convergence.json); refuted record, excluded from the accuracy claim: plane Couette channel: interior L2 velocity error vs u=U*y/H (finest rung) = 5.65% -- measured on the ``run.py --quick`` artefact, which overrides the DESIGN.md terminal time 1.2 H^2/nu down to 0.3 H^2/nu: the reading is a startup transient, not a property of the wall model (docs/audit_couette_wall_shear_reading.md; superseded by the design-time record from benchmarks/couette/out_design/results.json) (benchmarks/couette/out/results.json); refuted record, excluded from the accuracy claim: plane Couette channel: wall-shear error at the moving wall, |1 - tau_SPH/tau_exact| (the no-slip quantity itself; artefact gate 5 %) = 32.6% -- measured on the ``run.py --quick`` artefact, which overrides the DESIGN.md terminal time 1.2 H^2/nu down to 0.3 H^2/nu: the reading is a startup transient, not a property of the wall model (docs/audit_couette_wall_shear_reading.md; superseded by the design-time record from benchmarks/couette/out_design/results.json) (benchmarks/couette/out/results.json); refuted record, excluded from the accuracy claim: plane Couette channel: cross-channel mass-flux error |1 - Q_SPH/Q_exact| (artefact gate 5 %) = 7.16% -- measured on the ``run.py --quick`` artefact, which overrides the DESIGN.md terminal time 1.2 H^2/nu down to 0.3 H^2/nu: the reading is a startup transient, not a property of the wall model (docs/audit_couette_wall_shear_reading.md; superseded by the design-time record from benchmarks/couette/out_design/results.json) (benchmarks/couette/out/results.json)
